# Code Quality Issues

This directory contains GitHub issue templates generated from the automated code quality review conducted on 2026-01-06.

## Contents

- **10 issue templates** (issue-001-*.md through issue-010-*.md)
- **create_issues.sh** - Script to bulk-create all issues
- **code-quality-review.md** (in project root) - Full review report

## Creating Issues

### Option 1: Bulk Create with Script (Recommended)

Requires the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/):

```bash
# Install gh CLI if needed
# macOS: brew install gh
# Linux: See https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/docs/install_linux.md

# Authenticate
gh auth login

# Run the script
cd .github/quality-issues
./create_issues.sh
```

This will create all 10 issues with proper labels and formatting.

### Option 2: Manual Creation

Copy the content from each `issue-*.md` file and create issues manually:

1. Go to https://github.com/madmax983/GallifreyDB/issues/new
2. Copy title from the frontmatter (line starting with `title:`)
3. Copy body (everything after the `---` frontmatter)
4. Add labels from frontmatter (line starting with `labels:`)
5. Submit

### Option 3: GitHub API

If you have a personal access token:

```bash
# Set your token
export GH_TOKEN="your_token_here"

# For each issue:
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
  https://api.github.com/repos/madmax983/GallifreyDB/issues \
  -d '{"title":"Code Quality: ...","body":"...","labels":["code-quality","automated-scan"]}'
```

## Full Review Report

See `code-quality-review.md` in the project root for the complete review with:
- Detailed analysis of each issue
- Code examples and suggested fixes
- Testing coverage notes
- Overall recommendations

## Labels

All issues are tagged with:
- `code-quality` - Part of automated code quality review
- `automated-scan` - Generated by automated scanning
- Additional labels based on category:
  - `error-handling` - Issues with .unwrap()/.expect()
  - `refactoring` - Code complexity issues
  - `technical-debt` - TODOs and missing features
  - `api-design` - API ergonomics issues
  - `high-priority` - Should be addressed soon

## Notes

- These issues were identified by automated code review on 2026-01-06
- All issues include:
  - Exact file locations with line numbers
  - Current code state
  - Why it's problematic
  - Suggested improvements with code examples
  - Impact assessment
  - Effort estimate
- Review was based on CLAUDE.md coding standards and Rust best practices
